Version order is SemVer 2.0.0 precedence: compare MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH numerically; a version with a prerelease is lower than the same version without one; prerelease identifiers compare left to right, digit-only identifiers numerically, others in ASCII order, digit-only identifiers lower than others, and a longer identifier list is higher when all shared identifiers are equal. rng is one or more comparator sets joined by ' || '; a comparator set is one or more comparators separated by single spaces; version satisfies rng if it satisfies at least one comparator set. Comparators are: an operator ('<', '<=', '>', '>=', '=' or no operator, meaning '=') immediately followed by a full version that may have a prerelease; '^V' or '~V' where V is a full version without prerelease; and X-ranges 'M.m.x', 'M.x' and '*' (the letter x may also be written '*', as in 'M.m.*' or 'M.*'). Desugaring, where two comparators together mean both must hold: '^M.m.p' means '>=M.m.p <(M+1).0.0-0' when M > 0, '>=0.m.p <0.(m+1).0-0' when M == 0 and m > 0, and '>=0.0.p <0.0.(p+1)-0' when M == 0 and m == 0. '~M.m.p' means '>=M.m.p <M.(m+1).0-0'. 'M.m.x' means '>=M.m.0 <M.(m+1).0-0'; 'M.x' means '>=M.0.0 <(M+1).0.0-0'; '*' means '>=0.0.0'. The prerelease '-0' is the lowest possible prerelease, so '<2.0.0-0' excludes 2.0.0 and every 2.0.0 prerelease. Prerelease rule: a version WITH a prerelease satisfies a comparator set only if it satisfies every comparator of the set AND at least one comparator of the set that the user wrote with an explicit operator or no operator (not a '^', '~' or X-range comparator) has a prerelease and the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as the version. A version without a prerelease only needs to satisfy every comparator of the set. Inputs are always well formed.
